projection_contract.description: Each observation exposes a concrete, execution-derived projection that is byte-identical on the source and target sides after normalisation; bare control statuses such as {"result": "PASS"} are never emitted. Every probe reads the repository with the Python standard library only, so the projection is stable regardless of which repository runtime is installed.
projection_contract.source_and_target: both sides must really PASS; the projection is computed by executing the shared probe against the repository on each side
